structured.answer: It's a savings fund my employer and I both pay into (up to 7.5% from them and 2.5% from me). It's tax-free if I withdraw after 6 years (3 if it's for studying), and taking money out earlier is possible but taxed heavily. It's worth having because the employer's part is extra money I wouldn't get otherwise.

stuck.why: The gap looked tiny, so for a moment the lock-in didn't seem worth it. Only then did I see that the employer's money is left out of the comparison.
It isn't my number and I don't know my gross salary, so I didn't touch it
